Home/Services

Our Services

Metal roofing, metal siding, and board & batten — residential mostly, with light commercial work up to $150,000. Every job starts with a free, honest estimate.

We install metal roofs and metal siding on homes, barns, shops, and small commercial buildings across Tazewell County and the surrounding area. Most of what we do is residential — full roof replacements, repairs, and board & batten siding — plus selected commercial jobs sized for an owner-operated crew rather than a big regional contractor. We take on residential and light commercial projects up to $150,000 — the size where the owner is still on your roof, not managing it from an office. Whatever you're looking at, we'll tell you plainly whether it's a repair or a replacement, and what it's going to cost.
